cards.hint: A cross, then a loop that curls back through it. お has a small detached stroke on the right; あ has none.
Two separate strokes, the left one longer. り has them closer and steeper.
Like あ, but with a small detached stroke on the upper right.
Two horizontal strokes crossed by a curve. さ has only one.
A sharp angle pointing left. へ is a shallow peak.
Two short horizontal strokes.
One horizontal stroke, then a curve opening right. き has two horizontals.
One stroke, running down then hooking up to the right. つ runs across instead.
Vertical stroke through a horizontal, looping at the bottom.
A zigzag, then a long diagonal down-left.
Mirror image of さ — the curve opens to the left.
A single stroke running across and hooking down. し runs downward.
A vertical spine on the left, then two short horizontals.
Starts with a short cross-stroke — no vertical spine — and ends in a loop. め ends without the loop.
Vertical spine on the left, and the tail closes into a loop. れ and わ have no loop.
Vertical spine, one horizontal, then a shape with a tail. ほ adds a second horizontal.
A shallow, wide peak. く is a sharp angle pointing left.
は with one extra horizontal stroke.
Two horizontals crossed by a vertical that loops at the bottom.
Like す but with a detached tick on the right.
Like ぬ but the tail ends without closing into a loop.
A vertical hook crossed by two horizontals.
A short tick, then a curve opening left. ち has a horizontal stroke across the top.
Two strokes, the right one long and curving. い is wider and flatter.
Ends in a closed loop. ろ ends without one.
Vertical spine, and the tail hooks up to the right without looping. ね loops.
The same shape as る, but stops without the loop.
Vertical spine, and the tail curves in without looping or hooking out. ね loops, れ hooks.
One stroke: a small tick, then a long sweep down and up.
